headline: In this example dataset, the widest regional gap appears at treatment initiation — not at detection.
gap: Example data (not official statistics): the share of patients starting treatment within target timeframes ranges from 51% to 76% across counties, a 25 percentage-point spread. Detection (stage I–II share) is tighter, at a 10-point spread.
where_in_pathway: The gap widens along the pathway and is largest at the diagnosis → treatment step (Goal 3 of the National Cancer Strategy: patients start treatment within target timeframes). A secondary gap appears in primary → specialist referral.
what_to_do: Start with a county-level treatment-start clock: a named pathway coordinator and a weekly huddle on every new diagnosis that has not started treatment by day 14, and publish the Goal 3 on-time treatment indicator monthly.
